title: This AI Tool Breaks Down Any Movie Frame By Frame Locally
description:
Someone built a tool that watches an entire movie and turns it into frame by frame notes, completly on its own 🔥

It's called Lapian Notes. You drop in a film and the AI breaks down the scene structure, pulls out the emotional arcs, then syncs all of it to the player frame for frame. The wild part is it runs fully local, so nothing leaves you machine, and you can plug in whatever AI model you prefer.

For anyone running a content factory this is kind of a big deal, an agent basically does the whole job while you watch 😅 you just review the output after.

It lives on GitHub, search bkingfilm lapian notes if you wanna dig in ✨

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
